blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Defending champion San Beda and Jose Rizal University’s NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball game was suspended Friday due to problems at the venue at San Juan Arena. The game was stopped midway through the opening quarter after multiple players slipped on the hardwood. READ: San Beda embraces tough challenge as team to beat in NCAA With JRU holding a 9-3 lead, officials called for a stoppage before the game was officially suspended with 5:25 left in the first quarter.
